ValidationRule.description: Only Admin and CS Rep AND User.RevenueDepartment = 'DCS' can edit Forecasting fields
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISCHANGED(Most_Likely__c), ISCHANGED(Worst_Case__c), ISCHANGED(Most_Likely__c), ISCHANGED(Most_Likely_Next_FQ__c) ), NOT( OR( AND( ISPICKVAL($User.RevenueDepartment__c, 'DCS'), $Profile.Name = 'CS Rep' ), $Profile.Name = 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name = 'Integration User', $Profile.Name = 'Sales Ops' ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Only CS Rep User which has RevenueDepartment = 'DCS' can edit forecast fields
